name: Oyama
tagline: Shinjuku in 19 minutes and Shibuya in 24 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Itabashi City, served by Tobu Tojo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 30 minutes to Otemachi, 19 minutes to Shinjuku, 24 minutes to Shibuya and 45 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 29.6 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 8.8 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 29.6 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 24.6 m to 33.4 m, a difference of 8.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: スーパーみらべる 大山店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 6 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 東京都健康長寿医療センター, about 5 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 田崎病院, about 8 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tobu Tojo Line.
congestion: Tobu Tojo Line runs at 131% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 北池袋→池袋, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000, 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000, 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Itabashi-Kuyakushomae is ahead on how easy the shopping is, but Oyama is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi 8 minutes sooner than Oyama.

neighbours.lead: Oyama is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: About 1 km away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Oyama.

goodFor: People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: 鮫洲大山線 (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 9 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 4 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tobu Tojo Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
